structured_output.title: Additive `ciss` short name for ClusterIssuer; no ClusterIssuer in inputs
structured_output.content: The release note only says a `ciss` short name was added to the `ClusterIssuer` resource. It does not mention any removed or changed fields, behaviour or defaults. The environment summary lists just one installed CRD, `certificates.cert-manager.io` [v1], and only `apps/v1 Deployment` and `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests, so no ClusterIssuer CRD or manifest appears in what was supplied. Even if the operator does use ClusterIssuers, the evidence describes this as a kubectl convenience that changes nothing they need to act on; a human should confirm this before marking it not-affected.
